justification: The agent gets the current stock (8 units) and reorder point (20) correct and mentions the 3-day lead time, but critically misses the key finding that ORD-007 alone requests 50 units (exceeding the reorder point in a single order). Instead it invents specific order IDs (ORD-235, ORD-422, ORD-438, ORD-334, ORD-344) and a PO (PO-115) with fabricated quantities and dates not present in the ground truth, and constructs a demand velocity analysis (~11 units/day, 127 units over 9 orders) based on this hallucinated data. PO-008 (150 units incoming) is also not mentioned.
